referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. Port infrastructure expenditures and environmental interventions are allocated based the yearly throughput (444.7 Mio t). Vessel manufacturing is allocated based on the total kilometric performance (2126552 km) and its transport performance (75148dwt /unit). For each transport activity 2 ports are required.; UUID: 1846e2f7-dc18-37a6-9bb7-da1570d8798c
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module calls the modules addressing: production of vessel; construction and land use of port; operation, maintenance and disposal of port and vessel. In this module included is the energy consumption as well as the emissios.
referenceFunction.name: Transport, transoceanic freight ship
